description: This file contains functions and procedures to configure and manage a QMI-based network interface, including initialization, setup, teardown, and configuration of the modem, network registration, IP configuration, and data connections via QMI commands.

methods.name: proto_qmi_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the QMI protocol, adding string, integer, and boolean parameters.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Sets up the QMI network interface, including device initialization, PIN verification, network registration, and IP configuration.

methods.name: qmi_wds_stop
methods.description: Stops a specific WDS network session given client ID and profile handle.

methods.name: proto_qmi_teardown
methods.description: Teardown procedure for the QMI interface, stopping data sessions and releasing resources.
